linkedin.hook: Formal verification of Blend v2 pool architecture and the mechanics of isolated credit on Soroban
linkedin.copy:
Pooled liquidity protocols often force capital into shared-risk regimes where one bad debt event threatens solvency across unrelated positions. The formal verification of Blend v2 pool architecture provides the mathematical baseline required to treat b-tokens as modular primitives. By validating pool state transitions at the byte level, Soroban developers can build structured credit products without inheriting systemic pool contagion.

Vanna operates on top of this architecture through isolated SmartAccounts. Instead of commingling user collateral, each SmartAccount sandbox bounds its own margin requirements and execution rules. The integration supports yield-bearing b-tokens under a deterministic 1.10x Health Factor floor. Off-chain state ingestion through our Mercury indexer maintains roughly ~320ms latency, giving liquidation bots and automated vault strategies precise data without running into stale oracle reads.

Predictable network economics complete the stack. Fixed execution costs around 0.00014 XLM per contract call eliminate fee uncertainty during market drawdowns. For institutions modeling credit risk on Stellar, this combination of verified pool contracts and segregated margin accounts delivers a viable alternative to pooled debt. Testnet SmartAccount deployments are accessible at test.stellar.vanna.finance.

reddit.hook: Technical breakdown: Integrating Blend v2 b-tokens into Vanna SmartAccounts on Soroban testnet
reddit.copy:
Blend v2 recently published its formal verification specs, and the deterministic math on b-tokens gives us a solid primitive to build on. If you have farmed on Soroban, you already understand the risk profile of shared-collateral liquidations where one bad debt event can liquidate unrelated collateral pools.

We built Vanna to test an alternate model using isolated SmartAccounts. Instead of routing credit through a monolithic shared contract, every position operates inside an isolated sandbox proxy. Collateral parameters remain segregated, meaning a drawdown on an exotic pair never touches your core collateral assets.

Architecture and Risk Parameters

The integration wraps Blend v2 b-tokens directly within SmartAccount state storage. When you mint b-tokens from Blend, custody stays inside your proxy account. Health factor math calculates underlying collateral value against active borrows on every state change. We enforced a 1.10x Health Factor floor on testnet to prevent cascade liquidations while testing aggressive loops.

State sync runs through the Mercury indexer, which delivers ledger data at ~320ms latency. Because Soroban execution costs sit around 0.00014 XLM fixed gas per invocation, position rebalancing does not suffer from priority fee spikes when network volume picks up.

Testnet Deployment Instructions

If you want to test how b-token collateral behaves under leverage, spin up a test instance. Connect a Freighter testnet wallet, mint testnet assets from the faucet, and initialize your proxy account. You can borrow against b-tokens, test automated deleveraging limits, and verify the liquidation mechanics in an isolated environment.

Deploy your testnet SmartAccount sandbox at test.stellar.vanna.finance.

Disclosure: I am a core engineer building Vanna Protocol.

assets.critique: The visual metaphor is punchy and fits house style: an unstable, precarious glass tensegrity structure balancing liquid vs. an isolated, monolithic black granite block containing a sealed purple loop. However, the asset breaks production rules by embedding model-rendered text on a paper card prop in the scene rather than keeping pass-one completely devoid of text. Additionally, leaving the right side uncaptioned makes the meme asymmetrical and ungrounded without deterministic second-pass typography.
assets.fix: Re-render the frame without any paper card, label, or text in pass one. Typeset the comparison labels ('Manual Yield Looping / Cross-Margin Contagion' vs. 'Vanna SmartAccount / Isolated Position Loop') deterministically in post-processing using brand typography.
